body:
Unfortunately, InstantSearch can't do anything about that. The engine treats facet in as case-insensitive. Indeed like you said the fix for this is to ensure that the data sent to Algolia always share the same case.

Since it's not an InstantSearch related problem, I'll close the issue. You can write a message to [Algolia support](https://www.algolia.com/support/). It's always interesting for us to have feedback on the product, especially on corner case like this one.
